findings.current: “Chief Escort Seok D omin, escorts Gil Wangjun, Hong Seokjeong, Noh Dusam, and caravan porter Seok Sam…”
findings.defect: The draft mistranslates 표두 as the higher rank “Chief Escort,” which is reserved for 총표두, and also introduces an erroneous space into Seok Domin’s name.
findings.rationale: The source identifies Seok Domin as a 표두, not a 총표두, and spells his name continuously as 석도민.
findings.replacement: “Escort Captain Seok Domin, escorts Gil Wangjun, Hong Seokjeong, and Noh Dusam, and caravan porter Seok Sam…”
findings.source: “표두 석도민, 표사 길왕준, 홍석정, 노두삼, 쟁자수 석삼…….”

findings.current: Income inequality might have been severe, but one thousand silver nyang was enough money for an ordinary commoner to live in luxury for three generations.
findings.defect: The English makes a single commoner live for three generations instead of referring to three generations of a commoner’s family.
findings.rationale: 삼 대가 refers to three successive generations, so the subject must extend beyond one individual.
findings.replacement: Income inequality might have been severe, but one thousand silver nyang was enough for an ordinary commoner’s family to live in luxury for three generations.
findings.source: 아무리 빈부격차가 심하다지만 은자 천 냥은 평범한 양민이라면 삼 대가 호의호식할 수 있는 거금.

findings.current: As I clicked my tongue, the Lower District Sect member spoke up.
findings.defect: “Clicked my tongue” conveys irritation or disapproval, while 혀를 내두르다 here expresses astonishment at the enormous sum.
findings.rationale: The surrounding explanation emphasizes how staggeringly large one thousand silver nyang is, making amazement—not disapproval—the intended reaction.
findings.replacement: As I marveled at the sum, the Lower District Sect member spoke up.

findings.current: *She asked for more and then doubled down. She’s got some nerve.*
findings.defect: The draft misreads 묻고 as “asked for more” and uses “doubled down” figuratively, losing the joke that she has doubled the original 150-nyang figure to 300.
findings.rationale: 더블 directly points to the numerical doubling from 150 to 300, while 화통하다 admiringly characterizes her as bold and decisive.
findings.replacement: *She called it and doubled the amount. Talk about bold.*
findings.source: 묻고 더블을 불러 버리네. 화통하기 짝이 없다.

findings.defect: The draft omits Hwangbo Eom’s agitated stammer and changes his incredulous rhetorical outburst into a straightforward insult.
findings.rationale: 이, 이런 preserves his spluttering loss of composure, and 보았나 frames the insult as an incredulous exclamation.
findings.replacement: “I-I’ve never seen a pair of highway robbers like you!”

findings.current: The name Taeeul Merciless Sword represented the Zhongnan Sect, and in private, he was the Sect Leader’s senior martial brother.
findings.defect: The established hierarchy term 사형 is not rendered as “Senior Brother,” and “in private” can suggest secrecy rather than his personal relationship to the Sect Leader.
findings.rationale: 사형 is the binding term “Senior Brother,” while 사사로이는 contrasts his personal standing with the public weight of his title.
findings.replacement: The name Taeeul Merciless Sword represented the Zhongnan Sect, and on a personal level, he was also the Sect Leader’s Senior Brother.
findings.source: 태을무정검이라는 이름은 종남파를 대표하며, 사사로이는 장문인의 사형이기도 하다.

findings.current: “What I saw was that your Force had not yet been completed. Then how…”
findings.defect: “Had not yet been completed” is an unnatural passive construction that treats Force as something externally manufactured rather than a manifestation that was visibly incomplete.
findings.rationale: 아직 완성된 것이 아니었다 describes the observed state of his Force as incomplete.
findings.replacement: “What I saw was that your Force was not yet complete. Then how…”
findings.source: “노부가 본 것은, 너의 강기는 아직 완성된 것이 아니었다. 한데 어찌…….”

findings.current: “Is it because you’ve eaten too many years? You can’t seem to grasp the point. Think whatever you want about my realm. But…”
findings.defect: “Eaten too many years” is an unnatural calque of the Korean age expression and obscures Taekyung’s blunt mockery of Hwangbo Eom for being old.
findings.rationale: 나이를 많이 자시다 means to be advanced in age; in context, Taekyung weaponizes that ordinary expression as a disrespectful jab.
findings.replacement: “Is it because you’re so old? You can’t seem to grasp the point. Think whatever you want about my realm. But…”
findings.source: “거, 나이를 많이 자셔서 그런가. 요점을 파악 못 하시네. 내 경지에 대해서는 알아서 마음껏 생각하세요. 그런데…….”

findings.current: I understood the question he was feeling well enough.
findings.defect: “The question he was feeling” is not idiomatic English and miscasts 의문 as a literal question rather than Hwangbo Eom’s doubt or bafflement.
findings.rationale: The sentence refers to Taekyung understanding the uncertainty Hwangbo Eom feels about his apparently incomplete Force and unexpected strength.
findings.replacement: I could understand why he had his doubts.
findings.source: 지금 저자가 느끼고 있을 의문이 충분히 이해가 갔다.

summary: One hierarchy error and several localized subject, pragmatic-cue, humor, terminology, and natural-English issues.
